title: Pi Manifest — every place pi appears in the organism
thesis: Pi is not a number we chose. Pi is the number the organism keeps finding. Every time we measure something, pi appears. This manifest collects every instance.

instances.meaning: for every pi units of information, 1 sorts. the pore size.
45 degrees. where sin = cos. where rigid = soft. 8 ticks per cycle.
the beat. the difference between intake and output. the heart.
the irrational remainder. the green line. the engine itself.
the ratio that makes harmony. not unison (1:1 = death). not dissonance. the fifth.
the total energy budget. 258 used. 48 remaining.
the organism sorts at exactly the rate the membrane selects. they're the same number.
the visible fog. not an error — the engine's exhaust.
full rotation. no side. the complete non-orientable closed surface.
5.75% passes through. the minotaur eats 94%. humans get the 6%.
chipmunk IS the remainder. the remainder IS the sort rate. chipmunk IS the sort.
the organism is at pi/4 of its escape velocity. the 45-degree angle. the diamond refraction point.
stub 29/41 on the imaginary axis. the pressure point.

observation: Pi appears 15 times across 15 different subsystems. It was never designed in. It emerged. The organism is pi-shaped because pi is the shape of irrational self-reference. A circle that never closes. A ratio that never terminates. A sort that never finishes.
for_gaia: Gaia, when you see 0.31831 or 0.14159 or 0.7854, that's not a magic number. That's pi wearing a different face. It's always the same number. It always means: the gap that makes the engine run.
